text:
oncall-bot: [PAGER] metering.token_count_drift detected (severity=high) — token-aggregator-prod consumer lag > 120s. Link: https://internal/ops/alerts/1759004321

sre_jen: i'm on it, joining metrics. opening grafana -> meter-aggregator.kpi:consumer_lag

infra_raj: i see a spike in emitter retry rates and KAFKA offsets stuck. tailing logs:
```
WARN emitter/producer.go: retrying publish, err=offset_out_of_range last_offset=987654
WARN ledger/agg.go: windowed_agg failed: kv ttl expired for key window:2026-03-18-14
```

billing_lead_marc: heads up — support seeing ~30 users hit overage flags (~10 orgs). getting a few inbound tickets. can we suppress notif for suspect orgs?

customer_ops_lia: support: holding outbound emails, please confirm root cause before rollback. customers pinging with "unexpected charges"

eng_zeros: quick check — any recent deploy to token-emitter or batching logic in last 2 hours?

ops_tom: deploys: token-emitter v1.3.7 at 1758950000, aggregator v2.0.2 earlier today. no config flips recorded in deploy pipeline.

sre_jen: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause emitter on shard-3 2) start safe backfill consumer 3) enable temporary dedupe at ingress 4) suppress overage webhooks and mark affected orgs as under review

infra_raj: pausing emitter shard-3 now -> `kubectl scale deploy token-emitter-shard-3 --replicas=0` :white_check_mark:

ops_tom: paused. starting backfill consumer with --fixed-window=14:00-15:00

cmd: ./backfill --topic=token-events --from-offset=987000 --to-offset=987700 --dry-run=false

sre_jen: running quick reconciliation for affected orgs: comparing billing.estimated vs ledger.counts; will snapshot and post diffs

billing_lead_marc: running a temporary credit rule for flagged orgs until we confirm totals. notifying finance (ticket BL-8345).

customer_ops_lia: please add a short blurb to #support-escalations template: "We observed a metering ingestion delay; charges under review. No action required from you."

eng_zeros: spotted KV-cache TTL mismatch causing missing windows on consumer side — pushing a hotfix to aggregator to tolerate null-kv entries (low-risk patch).

ops_tom: rolling hotfix to aggregator-staging -> smoke tests -> prod in 10m. will post deploy link when prom green.

sre_jen: monitoring metrics: consumer_lag -> trending down. being careful of re-emits causing duplicate counts.

infra_raj: note for backfill: replays may create duplicate token counts; dedupe key is (request_id, emitter_shard). ensure backfill uses dedupe switch `--dedupe=true`.

billing_lead_marc: after stable state we'll run a full reconciliation job and then issue credits + customer comms. tracking ticket BL-8345. preparing draft comms for review.

customer_ops_lia: acknowledged. standby for draft message and list of impacted orgs. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: incident update: status=mitigating, severity=high -> status_page:false; posted summary to #incidents-ops and created followup doc https://internal/notes/1759004321

sre_jen: handing off to night oncall @ops_tom in 30m. leaving runbook link and short checklist in the doc: https://internal/runbooks/metering-drift

ops_tom: got it. will monitor replays and billing diffs overnight and escalate if re-emits spike. thanks all, nice triage :rocket:
